t: You're looking at the John Donne Memorial, a bronze bust in the garden south of St Paul's Cathedral. It's by the sculptor Nigel Boonham, who is known mainly for portrait sculptures. Donne faces east, towards his birthplace on Bread Street. He was a poet, scholar and soldier who became a cleric, and under royal patronage was made Dean of St Paul's from 1621 until 1631. He's considered the preeminent metaphysical poet, and was also known for his sermons.
